verdict.rationale: Aider is a local CLI/library pair-programming tool run against your own repo (add files, /test, /run, scripting via Coder.run) with no evidence of a cloud-hosted agent that autonomously builds, tests, and demos a feature end-to-end for asynchronous review; even community mentions of an experimental 'navigator/autonomy mode' describe local execution, not a cloud agent with a demo/review flow.
